decisions.reason: As a core-fit industrial door variant that remained marketed beyond launch, it likely performs at least near aspiration levels, and a large firm with some slack would usually keep it while demand uncertainty is still manageable.

Its insulated glazed specification fits the firm's compliance- and performance-oriented industrial offering, so management would be inclined to retain it unless results clearly fell below aspirations, which the available evidence does not suggest.

Because it received a dedicated page in both observed years and closely supports the firm's established sectional door business, it most likely cleared internal attention and aspiration thresholds enough to stay on the market.
